entries.01526cf2f1c7a1cf: A division that develops, manufactures and sells CNC systems (CNC and servo motors), which control machine tools through numerical control, and lasers, and provides maintenance services. Positioned as FANUC CORPORATION's core technology, the company explains that “CNC and servo motors are used in all products.” Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥208,478 million (up 7.0% year on year), accounting for 24.3%. The company states that demand in the machine tool industry, the main customer for CNC systems, was weak in Europe but performed well in Japan, India and China.
entries.19cff86f450effe1: A division that provides maintenance services for FANUC CORPORATION products worldwide. Based on its origins as a supplier of production goods, the company states that it will continue to provide maintenance services for as long as customers continue to use FANUC CORPORATION products. Under the slogan “Service First,” the company explains that it sought to strengthen its service structure with an emphasis on IT-enabled customer experience. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥141,143 million (up 4.4% year on year), accounting for 16.5%.
entries.963cb6820cde407b: A division that develops, manufactures and sells industrial robots and robot systems incorporating robots, and provides maintenance services. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥378,610 million (up 14.9% year on year), accounting for 44.1% of total consolidated revenue, making it the largest of the four product divisions. During the current period, the company developed the R-2000/E Series, a full model change of the large R-2000 series robot; the CRX-3iA, a collaborative robot with a mechanical unit weight of 11 kg that can be carried in one hand; the M-810/190-20B machining robot, which can be used for machining large parts such as automotive giga-castings; and the SR-9iA/R, a shelf-type SCARA robot. The company explains that in Japan, revenue from the automotive industry declined, while in China, EV-related and general industry sales performed well.
